class.name: larry_hardware/LarrySystemHardware
class.description: 6-wheel differential drive hardware interface for the Larry robot. Controls 6 EMG49 motors via MD10C R3 controllers aggregated through a microcontroller over UART serial using a simple ASCII protocol. Commands: M<left_pwm> <right_pwm>\r\n (-255..255) Feedback: E<left_ticks> <right_ticks>\r\n (cumulative signed counts)
